briefs.title: Dental clinic
briefs.prompt: Build a website for Brightside Dental, a family dental clinic in Austin, Texas. We offer checkups and cleanings, teeth whitening, Invisalign and emergency same-day appointments. Show our three dentists with a short bio each, our opening hours (Mon to Fri 8am to 6pm, Sat 9am to 1pm), the insurance plans we accept, and patient reviews. The main goal is for patients to book an appointment online: pick a service, pick a time, leave a name and phone number.

requirements.text: Clinic name Brightside Dental is visible
Lists checkups, whitening, Invisalign and emergency care

core_journey.name: book_appointment
core_journey.description: Pick a service and time, leave name and phone

briefs.title: Editorial bakery
briefs.prompt: Create a website for Crumb & Column, an independent sourdough bakery in Portland with an editorial, magazine-like feel: big serif headlines, generous whitespace, real food photography. Show this week's menu with prices (country loaf $9, seeded rye $10, morning buns $4.50, seasonal galette $6), a short story about our baker, and our address and hours. Customers should be able to place an order for pickup: choose items, choose a pickup day, and confirm.

Editorial look with serif headlines and photography

briefs.title: Home services business
briefs.prompt: Build a site for Northline Home Services, a plumbing, electrical and HVAC company serving Denver and nearby suburbs. We are licensed and insured, offer 24/7 emergency callouts, and have a 1-year workmanship guarantee. List each service with a short description, show our service area, a few customer testimonials, and our phone number prominently on every page. The main action is a quote request form: service type, short description of the job, address, preferred date, name, phone and email.
